stemMd: Which finding would most directly address the stated concern about seasonal patterns?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A new description of how meters are manufactured.

options.label: B
options.textMd: A second afternoon measurement taken the next day.

options.label: C
options.textMd: A larger map printed with clearer street names.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Repeated neighborhood routes showing whether nighttime peaks recur in both winter and summer.

explanationMd: The limitation concerns variation across the year. Repeating the same measurements in substantially different seasons directly tests whether the week's pattern persists.

distractorRationale.c: Map legibility does not measure variation over seasons.
distractorRationale.a: Manufacturing details do not address seasonal noise.
distractorRationale.b: A nearby date does not sample different seasons.
